How this comparison was made
  • Model: MLP 3 → 32 → 32 → 3 (Tanh), Adam lr 0.001, 100 epochs, trained in the Week 9 notebook on 40 CFD cases with Re 20–300. Not retrained for this page.
  • CFD reference: the notebook's own solver (staggered MAC grid, 50 × 50 cells, upwind convection, pressure projection) run at Re = 20, 60, …, 260 and 300–1000 in steps of 25. Every case met the notebook's checks (steady residual < 2×10⁻⁵, divergence RMS < 10⁻⁸). These fields are used only for checking, never for training.
  • Comparison: CFD and AI panels show the same quantity at the same Re with an identical color range. The error panel uses its own symmetric range.
  • Check: the in-browser network reproduces the notebook's Python outputs (verification status below).
